
FUNCTION Execute GLOBAL
    BLOCK Try_Execute
ON BLOCK ERROR all
SET bErrorHappened TO True
END
        WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: brEdge Control: appmask['Web Page \'file:///C:/Training/toggle-lab.html\'']['Paragraph \'A=off B=off C=on\'']) FOR 5 
        ON ERROR
            SET bErrorHappened TO True
            THROW ERROR
        END
        WebAutomation.GetDetailsOfElement BrowserInstance: brEdge Control: appmask['Web Page \'file:///C:/Training/toggle-lab.html\'']['Paragraph \'A=off B=off C=on\''] AttributeName: $'''Own Text''' AttributeValue=> txtStateBefore
        WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: brEdge Control: appmask['Web Page \'file:///C:/Training/toggle-lab.html\'']['Span \'tC\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
        WebAutomation.GetDetailsOfElement BrowserInstance: brEdge Control: appmask['Web Page \'file:///C:/Training/toggle-lab.html\'']['Paragraph \'A=off B=off C=on\''] AttributeName: $'''Own Text''' AttributeValue=> txtStateAfterClick
        WebAutomation.ExecuteJavascript BrowserInstance: brEdge Javascript: $'''function ExecuteScript() {
  try {
    var sel = \'%In_ToggleSelector%\';
    var want = \'%In_DesiredState%\';
    var el = document.querySelector(sel);
    if (!el) return \'NOT_FOUND\';
    function isOn() {
      if (el.type === \'checkbox\') return el.checked;
      return el.getAttribute(\'aria-checked\') === \'true\';
    }
    if ((want === \'on\') === isOn()) return \'ALREADY_\' + want.toUpperCase();
    el.click();
    if ((want === \'on\') === isOn()) return want.toUpperCase();
    el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(\'pointerdown\', { bubbles: true }));
    if ((want === \'on\') === isOn()) return want.toUpperCase();
    return \'IGNORED\';
  } catch (e) {
    return \'JS_ERROR: \' + e.message;
  }
}''' Result=> txtResult
        IF (txtResult <> 'ON' AND txtResult <> 'OFF' AND txtResult <> 'ALREADY_ON' AND txtResult <> 'ALREADY_OFF') = True THEN
            FlowControl.ThrowCustomError CustomErrorCode: $'''ToggleFailed''' CustomErrorMessage: $'''Toggle %In_ToggleSelector% failed: %txtResult%'''
        END
        WebAutomation.GetDetailsOfElement BrowserInstance: brEdge Control: appmask['Web Page \'file:///C:/Training/toggle-lab.html\'']['Paragraph \'A=off B=off C=on\''] AttributeName: $'''Own Text''' AttributeValue=> txtStateAfter
    END
END FUNCTION
